review_candidates.title: Senior Security Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: About the Role: We're hiring our first dedicated security leader on the engineering side. You'll build our security program from the ground up, owning both application security and infrastructure security. You'll work directly with leadership to set priorities, decide where the real risks are, and put the right controls in place. Interesting candidates are welcome to send their updated resumes to: alaa.elmaghraby@leadliaison.com  What You'll Do: Define and run the security program: strategy, roa
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: 6+ years in security engineering, with hands-on AppSec and cloud infrastructure experience Deep AWS security knowledge (IAM, VPC, logging, KMS, and related services) Strong grasp of OWASP Top 10, API top 10 and common vulnerability classes, and secure code review Experience with identity and access management, encryption standards, and PKI Incident response experience - Comfort building from scratch: you can prioritize, say no, and ship pragmatic controls Clear communication with both engineers and executives Experience as a first or early security hire is a plus.
